notes: B-1, titled COURBES ELLIPTIQUES : BIBLIOGRAPHIE, has three numbered sections: elliptic/modular functions; complex multiplication by analytic methods; and algebraic function fields of one variable. It contains ten bibliographical entries. Dates printed on this leaf are 1964 (4ème édition), 1922, 1908, 1924, 1927, 1927 and 1931 for Hasse’s two parts, 1957-1958, 1958, 1951 and 1963. The Hasse ranges are p.115-139 in volume 157 and p.64-88 in volume 165; these are transcribed ranges, not independently verified publication data. The damaged Fueter title reads Multiplik.tion at the visible surface; its normal spelling is not supplied in the transcription. The original overtyped letter in Gauthier remains doubtful. No mathematical assertion is argued or checked on this bibliography leaf, and no external catalogue was consulted.
legibility: The ten entries and their headings are clear, including accents, dates and ranges. The old layer in Gauthier is least secure. A single damaged type position in the Fueter title was not reconstructed from spelling. H has a description only.
